description:
## Problem
The Databricks and Snowflake tuned templates have no benefit evidence. The harness gains cloud support in `cloud-tuned-benefit-measurement-20261008`; this item runs it.

## Change
- Once both live certifications have passed, run the harness for TPC-H on Databricks and Snowflake, and TPC-DS if the approved budget allows. Use arms `notuning` and tuned, with both arms settled.
- Record clustering state, settle condition, load and maintenance time, cost and CIs.
- Apply the benefit rule, record a verdict per template and tier, and update the evidence states in `benchbox/core/tuning/profiles/template_evidence.yaml`.

## Decision gates
- Each live run needs explicit owner approval naming the command, maximum runtime, maximum cost (the harness `--max-cost`), log path and stop condition. Without it, do not start.
- The owner picks the scale factor(s). The evidence records that they are far below the vendors' 1 TB / multi-TB guidance.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Use dedicated database names; never shared ones.
- Never relax a certification assertion.
- Stop at the approved cost cap.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit owner approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
